51/S0.subgoal: Explain the approach for optimizing VR navigation to minimize cybersickness.

51/S1.subgoal: Describe the factors affecting exposure duration and the concept of semi-interactive tours.

51/S2.subgoal: Describe two approaches for optimizing VR tour duration.

51/S3.subgoal: Formulate the navigation problem as a weighted graph.

51/S4.subgoal: Calculate travel time between connected nodes using the natural walking model.

51/S5.subgoal: Explain how to map the navigation problem to a standard Traveling Salesman Problem.

51/S6.subgoal: Describe the step-by-step algorithm to find the optimal path.

51/S7.subgoal: Summarize the navigation optimization steps and preview the next approach.
